findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe XML parsing with lxml
 * @description Instantiating an lxml parser with resolve_entities=True or no_network=False can lead to XXE or SSRF.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-lxml-config
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-611
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("lxml").getMember("etree").getMember(["XMLParser", "HTMLParser"]).getACall() and
  (
    call.getArgByName("resolve_entities").asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = true
    or
    call.getArgByName("no_network").asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = false
    or
    // Check if huge_tree is enabled which might allow DoS
    call.getArgByName("huge_tree").asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = true
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe lxml parser configuration."
findings.hypothesis: Check for explicitly unsafe lxml parser configurations.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name ReDoS in regex
 * @description Regular expressions with exponential complexity can lead to Denial of Service
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/redos
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-1333
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::Node arg
where
  call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "match", "search", "findall", "finditer", "split", "sub", "subn"]).getACall() and
  arg = call.getArg(0) and
  // We are looking for regex patterns that might be complex. 
  // This is a heuristic check for static regex strings that look suspicious.
  // A full ReDoS analysis is complex, so we look for nested quantifiers.
  exists(string pattern |
    pattern = arg.asExpr().(StrConst).getText() and
    pattern.regexpMatch(".*\\([^)]*\\+.*\\)\\+.*|.*\\([^)]*\\*.*\\)\\*.*|.*\\([^)]*\\+.*\\)\\*.*|.*\\([^)]*\\*.*\\)\\+.*")
  )
select call, "Potential ReDoS vulnerability in regex pattern."
findings.hypothesis: Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) in regex patterns.

    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall()
  )
